How to Make Your Book:

  1. Set up the first scene in your story.
  2. Take a photograph of the scene and practise saying the sentence that goes with that scene (you could write it down and include it in the photo if you like, as in the picture above).
  3. Repeat with the rest of the story. You are aiming for about six scenes in total.
  4. You can then look through the pictures in order to read your story!


Extra Ideas:

  • You could also take a picture for your front cover.
  • Some phones let you draw on pictures once you’ve taken them – you could add bits of drawing to help make it more exciting, e.g. zoom lines if a character is moving fast.
  • You could print your story and make a physical book.
  • If you have an eBook creating app on your phone, you could turn your story into a book.
  • If you don’t want to take photos, you could draw a picture to go with each sentence instead and make a paper book.
In this activity, you are going to be making your own story into some kind of book. You can use the story you made up in Activity 2 or make up a new one!
